title: Hamletworks (hamletworks.org): The Enfolded Hamlet and Hamlet textual notes
institution: Bernice W. Kliman (Nassau Community College, SUNY) and the hamletworks.org editors; webmaster Jeffery Triggs
author: William Shakespeare
notes: Research site for Shakespeare's Hamlet. It offers the 'Enfolded Hamlet' (Bernice Kliman, 1996) as linked texts of the Second Quarto (1604/5) and the First Folio (1623) in exact original spelling, a modern enfolded text, line-by-line commentary and textual notes, and diplomatic versions of the First Quarto (1603) and Sixth Quarto as PDF/DjVu files, plus later editions and promptbooks. The domain redirects to a different host name (server-66-113-234-189.da.direct). Counts are ours: 2 texts (Q2 and F1) and about 63,400 words, counted in the text pages of the Q2 (33,557) and F1 (29,815) transcriptions; the Q1 and Q6 files are not counted, and the figure includes some line-number and apparatus tokens. The introduction page was last modified in February 2025. Copyright is held by the editors; reading is free.
